sdkBundles.description: Bundled @servicenow/sdk + @servicenow/glide for authoring Flow Designer flows, Playbooks, Script Includes, ACLs, REST Messages, Connection Aliases, and more declaratively in TypeScript.
sdkBundles.releaseSummary: Maintenance/bug-fix release over 4.8.1 — safe drop-in. Fixes the ScheduledScript run_time/run_period '[object Object]' serialisation bug (Time()/Duration() and plain-object forms now both produce correct output — the Nova Record() workaround is no longer needed), plus a large batch of Flow/ClientScript/ImportSet/SLA transform-and-build reliability fixes: Look Up Record parameter naming, flow snapshot churn (main_snapshot), internalName handling, Choice dropdown-with-None regression, inline scripts in TemplateValue, ClientScript order preservation, and ImportSet/SLA numeric+reference defaults. Adds multi-language choice labels, ATF TestingLibrary UI test step, Role federatedId, and Now Assist provider/model updates. Recommended for all SDK-enabled projects.

servers.description: Drive a real browser for ServiceNow UI work — flow validation, workspace probing, portal smoke, dashboard verification, playbook UI checks. Per-project Chromium profile preserves saved passwords, history, and any persistent cookies (incl. SN 'Remember me' sessions when ticked at login).

headed.label: Show browser window (headed mode)
headed.description: Headed mode lets you watch the automation. Disable for headless / CI.

screenshotsDir.label: Screenshots folder
screenshotsDir.description: Where Playwright saves screenshots. Path is relative to project root.

profileDir.label: Browser profile folder
profileDir.description: Persistent Chromium profile per project. Preserves saved passwords, history, localStorage, and any cookies the server flags as persistent. SN's default session cookie is session-only — tick 'Remember me' at login if you want auth to survive browser close. Per-project keeps SN instance sessions isolated.

actionTimeoutMs.label: Action timeout (ms)
actionTimeoutMs.description: Client-side timeout for each Playwright action (click, screenshot, etc.). Playwright's own default of 5000ms is often too tight for ServiceNow UIs on corporate networks - screenshots wait on webfonts that can stall at a proxy.

useCases: Building or validating Flow Designer flows

servers.description: Interactive 3D galaxy visualization for Sentinel discovery data. Renders tables, artifacts, and relationships as an explorable solar system — tables are suns, artifacts orbit as planets, edges are gravitational links. Requires Sentinel cache data (run discover_table_ecosystem first).

bloomIntensity.label: Bloom / glow intensity
bloomIntensity.description: Controls the glow effect on nodes and particles

particleDensity.label: Particle density
particleDensity.description: Number of ambient particles. Lower for slower GPUs.

cameraMode.label: Default camera mode
cameraMode.description: Orbit locks onto a focal point. Fly allows WASD free navigation.

useCases: Exploring a ServiceNow instance's table ecosystem in 3D
Identifying configuration hotspots and sprawl visually

servers.description: Official Atlassian Rovo remote MCP server - live Jira issue + Confluence page read/write under your own Atlassian sign-in (OAuth in-session, permissions follow your Atlassian roles). No install, no credentials stored by Nova: enable per project, then sign in once via /mcp (Claude) or codex mcp login (Codex). Lets sn-story-manager round-trip a live Jira backlog instead of exporting CSV.
useCases: Round-trip the project backlog to live Jira from sn-story-manager (CSV fallback retained)
Read acceptance criteria / comments from Jira issues during builds
Publish build notes or release summaries to Confluence pages

servers.description: Microsoft's official remote MCP server for SharePoint (upload files, metadata, search, lists) via the Agent 365 tooling gateway. Actions run as the signed-in user (Entra). Requires: Microsoft 365 Copilot licence, and an Entra enterprise app registered with the matching WorkIQ-* API permission (admin consent). Get Tenant ID + App (client) ID from the Entra admin center. PREVIEW: Microsoft may rename server paths - if Test connection fails, verify the server path against learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-agent-365/tooling-servers-overview and correct it in Configure.

tenantId.description: Directory (tenant) ID from the Microsoft Entra admin center

clientId.label: Entra app client ID
clientId.description: Application (client) ID of the registered enterprise app holding the WorkIQ-SharePointServer permission

serverPath.label: Server path
serverPath.description: Work IQ server path segment (preview - confirm against the Microsoft Agent 365 docs if Test connection fails)

useCases: Pull requirement docs / workshop notes from customer SharePoint during discovery
Publish deliverables (UAT packs, release notes) to the engagement site
